('discount_enabled', '0', 'Discount Enabled', 'Toggle to show/hide the discount button on the estimate', 'pricing'),

('show_pricing', '1', 'Show Pricing on Estimate', 'When disabled, the estimate shows only a scope of work without any dollar amounts', 'pricing');
